Chapter one · The girl behind the words

More than a pretty face.
An entire story.

The most interesting thing about a person is everything you cannot see at first glance.

A soft heart in a very loud world.
A note about me

Hi, I'm Beth.
It's lovely to meet you.

Beth Hlalele. A girl with a thousand feelings, a head full of thoughts she sometimes cannot explain, and a heart that has never quite learned how to do anything halfway.

I'm the kind of person who can turn one conversation into an entire chapter, a tiny feeling into a poem, and an ordinary moment into something I will probably think about at three in the morning.

I love meaningful conversations, the kind of music that makes you stare out of a window dramatically, words that feel like home, and people who make life a little softer.

I am still figuring things out. I'm learning, growing, overthinking, dreaming, and occasionally wondering what exactly I'm doing with my life. But there is something beautiful about being a work in progress.

I'm here to live, to feel, to create, to love, and to become someone my younger self would be proud of.

With love, Beth ♡
Chapter two · The many sides of me

A little complicated.
A lot of character.

If you really want to understand Beth, you have to understand the little things that make her who she is.

01 / THE POET

Words are my thing.

I feel things in paragraphs. I turn emotions into sentences and the things I cannot say out loud into something someone else might read and finally understand.

02 / THE ROMANTIC

Down bad for love.

Love letters, thoughtful gestures, deep conversations, and feeling understood? I am absolutely not beating the hopeless romantic allegations—and honestly, I don't want to.

03 / THE OVERTHINKER

My mind never clocks out.

I can replay a moment, imagine twelve different outcomes, and create an entire story from one little thought. My brain has a full-time job. Unfortunately, it refuses to pay me.

04 / THE DREAMER

Made for more.

There is a version of me I am constantly working towards: a girl with bigger dreams, a creative mind, and the courage to become everything she imagines.

05 / THE SOFTIE

A heart that feels.

I care about the little things. I notice changes in energy, remember words people forget saying, and appreciate the kind of kindness that asks for nothing in return.

06 / THE MAIN CHARACTER

Still becoming her.

I am allowed to have unfinished chapters, make mistakes, start again, and figure it out slowly. My life is not behind schedule. I am living it in real time.

Chapter three · From my heart to the page

Dear world,
I've been writing again.

I don't always know how to explain what I feel. But give me a blank page, and suddenly my heart has a language.

The art of feeling

Some feelings deserve more than ordinary words.

Poetry is where I put the things I cannot carry quietly. It is where love becomes a language, sadness finds a sentence, and little pieces of life become something beautiful enough to keep.

“
An original piece by Beth

i think in feelings

i think in feelings and speak in almosts, in words i rehearse but rarely release. i find entire worlds in the smallest of moments, and call it a gift to feel things this deeply. perhaps that is my magic: not that life is always beautiful, but that even when it isn't, i keep looking for beauty.
Chapter four · The plot is plotting

Romanticising life.
Surviving the plot.

Somewhere between having big dreams and trying to get through the week, there is a girl doing her best.

♡
My favourite subject

Love, unfortunately.

I love the idea of loving someone intentionally. The patience, vulnerability, little details, laughter, effort, and feeling of being safe enough to be yourself.

I believe love should feel like a place where two people can grow, not a place where either has to disappear.

If love is a language, I'm writing a whole dictionary.
✧
Academic survival diary

Me versus school.

My relationship with school has its own character development. One minute I'm ambitious, the next I'm staring at an assignment wondering who decided all these deadlines were a good idea.

I'm learning that small steps still count: showing up, asking for help, trying again, and trusting myself to learn.

Educated, exhausted, and still full of potential.
☼
A gentle reminder

Life is a work in progress.

Some days I feel like I have everything figured out. Other days, I have more questions than answers. I'm learning not to confuse uncertainty with failure.

I am allowed to pause, take the scenic route, and discover what truly matters to me.

I am a person, not a finished product.
✿
The little things

My kind of happiness.

Good music. Beautiful words. Warm colours. Genuine laughter. Conversations that last for hours. A thoughtful message. A poem that says exactly what I could not.

Sometimes happiness is a collection of little moments I remember to appreciate.

Collecting moments, not perfect days.
“
I want to live a life that gives me something to write about, and write words that remind me why living was worth it.

Something I believe · Beth Hlalele

If my personality

The final chapter · A little note

Before you leave,
one last thing.

If you've made it this far, thank you for taking a little walk through my world. I hope you have met more than just a name on a screen.

You've met a girl who is learning how to live, who loves words because they help her understand what makes her human, who believes in meaningful connections, and who is still discovering all the things she can become.

I am not every beautiful thing I hope to be yet. I have lessons to learn, dreams to chase, poems to write, places to see, and so much life still waiting to happen.

I am here. I am trying. I am creating. I am choosing to believe that my story can be beautiful without needing to be perfect.

I will always be a girl who believes there is something worth loving, something worth learning, and something worth writing about.

Until the next chapter, Beth ♡
